biography.plain_text: David Legrant Correia is a Portuguese businessman and owner of Medicare, the Lisbon health-plan company he leads as chief executive. A marketing graduate, he cofounded the communications business Mundicall in 1999 and subsequently became its sole owner. He also leads Lifefit, a subscription platform combining health, nutrition and fitness services.

long_biography.plain_text:
David Legrant expanded Medicare's health plans to include video consultations and electronic prescriptions. Customers could speak to a doctor through a computer, tablet or phone, extending a service previously organised around appointments within a network of providers. The company arranged access to care rather than underwriting medical insurance.

Under his leadership, Medicare also established Wecare, a programme supporting families and hospitals. Alongside food parcels, it funded repairs to staff bathrooms and changing rooms at Hospital Garcia de Orta. The chronic-pain department at Centro Hospitalar Lisboa Norte received an ultrasound machine through the programme.
